runtimeProjectionPolicy.selectionNote: Version 1 runtime projection uses the published straight-in VOR/DME minima for VOR RWY 16C.
Version 1 runtime projection uses the published straight-in VOR/DME minima for VOR RWY 34C.
Version 1 runtime projection uses ILS CAT I minima only. LOC-DME and CAT II/III remain publication-only and are not projected into the runtime candidate.
Version 1 runtime projection uses the published LNAV straight-in minima as the single runtime minimum for RNP RWY 16C.
Version 1 runtime projection uses the published LNAV straight-in minima at the standard 2.5 percent missed-approach climb gradient as the single runtime minimum for RNP RWY 34C.

towerScopeApproaches.note: LOWG default approach and missed-approach sequences are now projected as tower-scope IFR candidates. Chart-derived minima and a runtime-selection policy are now attached for the first current-core subset (VOR 16C, VOR 34C, RNP 16C, RNP 34C, ILS 34C), while LOC remains publication-only. Final/missed leg compilation and GBG hold-loop geometry are still handled later in the runtime candidate projection step.

publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Useful as a final plate-style review artifact reference, even though structured runway and taxi data continue to come primarily from apt.dat and CAD.
notes: The taxi-layout sheet provides a compact aerodrome-reference plate tying together runway data, taxi layout, frequencies, and nearby parachute-area context.

publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Local aerodrome regulations from the OFM briefing pages.
preCoordinationRequiredFor: Solo flights by student pilots without a qualified instructor on board.
Flights with a special program, including aerial work, aerobatics, parachute activity, and similar special operations.
trafficCircuitRestrictions: Traffic circuits on grass runways 16L/34R (east) and 16R/34L (west) are not allowed on Saturdays after 1300 local time, on Sundays and public holidays all day, and after 2200 local time until end of operating hours on other days.
Helicopter traffic circuits on grass runways 16L/34R and 16R/34L are subject to the same time restrictions.

arrivalPolicy: Arrival routes/sectors end overhead AUTOBAHN-OST, KALSDORF, SENDER DOBL, or AUTOBAHN-WEST; hold there for further clearance unless approach or landing clearance has already been received.
For noise abatement, maximum altitudes on entry routes/sectors should be maintained as long as practicable.
commFailureProcedures: Before receiving an entry clearance: if possible divert to an uncontrolled aerodrome; otherwise squawk 7600 and enter the CTR via the NORDO route GLEISDORF -> LASSNITZHÖHE -> AUTOBAHN-OST, then continue to the NORDO holding east of the tower at 2500 ft and await light signals.

After receiving an entry clearance: squawk 7600, leave the CTR without delay via the entry route/sector and divert if possible, except for the GLEISDORF -> LASSNITZHÖHE -> AUTOBAHN-OST and SECTOR ECHO -> KALSDORF cases, then re-enter via the NORDO route to the NORDO holding east of the tower at 2500 ft and await light signals.
departurePolicy: Unless otherwise instructed by ATC, departing VFR flights should omit position reports overhead AUTOBAHN-OST, KALSDORF, AUTOBAHN-WEST, and SENDER DOBL.
For noise abatement, the published maximum altitudes on departure routes/sectors should be reached as soon as practicable.
publishedAerodromeInformation.note: General VFR approach/departure/transit briefing and comm-failure procedure.
transitPolicy: Transit flights will be cleared only if traffic situation permits.

publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Miscellaneous operational notes with real training value.
notes: GRAZ TWR provides radar service for VFR flights.
Outside duty hours of the Graz ATC unit, pilots shall contact ACC/FIC Wien for clearance.
Glider flying and parachute jumping are permitted in the western area of the aerodrome only.
Parachute area established west of the airport over the lakes.
Preferably power flying should be conducted in the eastern area of the aerodrome only (traffic circuits to the east).
The west traffic circuit around runway 16R/34L is intended to keep traffic clear of the parachute area and should be flown as accurately as possible.
The west traffic circuit is not available for flights from and to 16L/34R.

publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Glider-operations-specific aerodrome information from the dedicated ground sheet.
notes: Runway and taxiway surfaces in the glider-ops area require clearance by GRAZ TWR.
ATC area of responsibility for glider ops includes runway 16R/34L and attached taxiways; contact Tower for clearance.
Temporary reserved areas apply; see AIC B 1/24.

publishedAerodromeInformation.note: Transit geometry and sector semantics still need a deeper pass if we want to model through-transits explicitly.
notes: The transit sheet provides the combined CTR/TMA context for PRC-1 through PRC-5 and identifies FIC SOUTH / WIEN INFORM as the relevant information service outside the immediate LOWG control context.
